name: Pamphilus

findings.what: The reason treats the own-words question as settled ('his one named work is of disputed authorship'). But Eusebius's own text calls the Apology for Origen a joint work 'written by us and Pamphilus', and Answer C a counts jointly written work. Its authorship is disputed only by Jerome, writing as Rufinus's opponent (53978-53986, where Jerome also admits he earlier accepted it). This is a question for Mark, not a settled fail.
findings.fix: Keep hold, but rewrite the reason to put the point to Mark. Name both works (the Acts fragments and the Apology), not 'his one named work'.
